versions.localizedDescription:
**YTKACE v0.8.1**
by @itzzace0

**What's new:**
• Search in the YTKACE section of YouTube's settings
• Volume gesture can now use both sides of the player
• The YTKACE section in YouTube's settings now has icons and MAIN / VIDEO / APP / ABOUT grouping, matching the main settings page
• Version and device info at the bottom of the YTKACE section, same as the main settings page

**Fixed:**
• Fixed the YouTube logo flickering when Remove logo is enabled
• Fixed downloads failing with "YouTube requires stream authorization" on some accounts
• Fixed missing translations across settings page titles, section headers and descriptions, and the YTKACE rows in YouTube's settings
